<tool_call>
<function=execute_sql>
<parameter=sql>
WITH merchant_info AS (
    SELECT merchant, account_type, capture_delay, merchant_category_code
    FROM merchant_data
    WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store'
),
payments_filtered AS (
    SELECT p.*,
           CASE WHEN p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS is_intracountry
    FROM payments p
    WHERE p.merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store'
      AND p.year = 2023
      AND p.day_of_year >= 244
      AND p.day_of_year <= 273
),
matched AS (
    SELECT pf.psp_reference, pf.eur_amount, f.fixed_amount, f.rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pf.psp_reference ORDER BY f.ID) as rn
    FROM payments_filtered pf
    CROSS JOIN merchant_info mi
    JOIN fees f ON
        (f.card_scheme = '' OR f.card_scheme = pf.card_scheme)
        AND (f.account_type = [] OR f.account_type @> ARRAY[mi.account_type])
        AND (f.capture_delay = '' OR f.capture_delay = mi.capture_delay)
        AND (f.merchant_category_code = [] OR f.merchant_category_code @> ARRAY[mi.merchant_category_code])
        AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = pf.is_credit)
        AND (f.aci = [] OR f.aci @> ARRAY[pf.aci])
        AND (f.intracountry::VARCHAR = '' OR f.intracountry = pf.is_intracountry)
)
SELECT SUM(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000.0) as total_fees, COUNT(*) as matched_txns
FROM matched
WHERE rn = 1
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
